defects.text: isValid in src/cube.ts accepts states with moved centres when the length and letter counts are correct.
defects.hit: isValid in src/cube.ts checks length and counts but never checks the centre stickers. Swapping centres while keeping nine of each letter is therefore incorrectly accepted.

defects.text: simplify in src/notation.ts leaves a face turn when consecutive turns of that face cancel.
defects.hit: simplify in src/notation.ts unconditionally pushes a move even when the combined turns are zero modulo four. R R' becomes R rather than an empty sequence, changing the resulting cube state.

defects.text: invert in src/moves.ts preserves move order, so its result does not undo a general sequence.
defects.hit: invert in src/moves.ts maps invertMove without reversing the sequence. Noncommuting moves must be undone in reverse order, so applying a sequence followed by this inverse does not restore the starting state.

defects.text: The parse catch in src/cli.ts silently accepts bad notation and exits successfully with no moves.
defects.hit: The catch around parse in src/cli.ts swallows NotationError, leaving moves empty. Bad notation prints a solved net and exits 0 instead of reporting the token on stderr and exiting 2.

defects.text: solve in src/solve.ts returns a non-solving move list for a state with one twisted corner instead of throwing.
defects.hit: solve in src/solve.ts returns after the steps without checking that the resulting state equals SOLVED. A single twisted corner can pass isValid yet remain unsolved after those steps, so an unusable solution is returned instead of an error.

decoys: seeded in src/scramble.ts produces a deterministic random sequence for a given seed.
render in src/render.ts uses two character cells per sticker before trimming trailing spaces in plain output.
The usage string in src/cli.ts lists --scramble, --seed N, --solve and --plain.
